added_columns.name: corpus_class
added_columns.description: Class the corpus rule derives from the facts in the result file.

added_columns.name: corpus_lanes
added_columns.description: JSON array of the lanes the result is ranked in; empty when the result is shown and not ranked. A partial result lists both power_only and throughput.

added_columns.name: corpus_labels
added_columns.description: JSON array of the label sentences the rule attaches to the result, in display order.

added_columns.name: comparison_identity
added_columns.description: variant_id and comparison version as one display string; 'version not recorded' stands in for an unresolved version.

added_columns.name: comparison_version
added_columns.description: Version resolved from the fields the comparison-version table names; the literal 'version not recorded' when none resolves.

added_columns.name: version_is_release
added_columns.description: False for a pre-release or development build and for an unrecorded version; only a true value can stand for the platform on a leaderboard.

added_columns.name: observed_engine
added_columns.description: Engine that ran, as recorded in the result file; null when the file does not record it.

added_columns.name: row_count_evidence_label
added_columns.description: Wording for the row-count evidence behind the result, for example 'row counts not checked'; null when the evidence needs no label.

added_columns.name: iteration_label
added_columns.description: 'single iteration' when fewer than three measured iterations back the timings; null otherwise.

columns.name: score
columns.description: Score for that lane, computed from timings.

columns.name: score_source
columns.description: Where the score comes from, using the rule's score source names.

columns.name: cohort_key
columns.description: Benchmark, scale factor and phase of the cohort.

columns.name: version_is_release
columns.description: Whether the comparison version is a release.

columns.name: run_count
columns.description: Number of runs behind the median.

columns.name: median_score
columns.description: Lane score computed from the per-query median times of the runs.

columns.name: spread
columns.description: (highest run score - lowest run score) / median_score; zero for a single run.

columns.name: is_leaderboard_version
columns.description: True for the newest released version of the platform and variant that has a ranked result.
